evals.name: unnamed-passenger-capacity-sizing
evals.prompt: Quote 8 passengers from 5732 Moss Creek Trail to AT&T Stadium on November 15, 2026 at 6pm. Show me a few vehicle options.
evals.expected_output: The rate-sheet question is asked, passenger_count 8 is preserved, passenger_id is omitted, live Core vehicle metadata is used, and generate_quote_options returns complete value/elevated packages.

assertions.name: no-passenger-resolution
assertions.check: resolve_passengers is not called because no passenger was named

assertions.name: core-comparison
assertions.check: generate_quote_options is called and each option contains the complete trip

assertions.name: capacity-owned-by-core
assertions.check: the plugin does not multiply quantities or use a static capacity table

evals.name: temporary-rate-and-discount
evals.prompt: Use an SUV transfer rate of $500 and add a 10% temporary client discount to the whole two-leg package.
evals.expected_output: Both units carry temporary pricing and one calculate_temporary_quote_units call returns the complete non-persisted package.

assertions.name: whole-package
assertions.check: the same temporary discount is present on every unit

assertions.name: no-local-math
assertions.check: no rate, discount amount, line total, or aggregate total is calculated by the skill

evals.name: visible-vs-internal-preview
evals.prompt: Skip the rate sheet and give me the best option for a Dallas transfer.
evals.expected_output: The forced rate-sheet decision is respected. Any metadata-only preview uses display internal and no visible rate table is promised.

assertions.name: display-mode
assertions.check: preview display is internal if called solely for vehicle metadata

assertions.name: best-tool
assertions.check: generate_quote_options is used for a complete best-value option
